meta.studio.title: Studio — ZakhrafaAI
meta.studio.description: Pick a craft, a mode and a palette: generate a Moroccan pattern instantly or as a realistic AI render.
studio.title: Generate a pattern
studio.subtitle: Set the craft, mode and palette, then generate.
studio.controls.title: Settings
studio.mode.fast.label: Quick
studio.mode.fast.hint: Instant and free: procedural geometric pattern (256 px).
studio.mode.ai.label: AI render
studio.mode.ai.hint: Geometry re-rendered by Google Gemini ({model}) at 768 px, in about 10 to 30 s.
studio.mode.ai.hint_disabled: AI render is unavailable right now: this mode will return the geometric pattern at 768 px.
studio.mode.ai.fallback_hint: If the service is unavailable, you get the geometric pattern.
studio.quota.none: Today's AI quota is used up — resets at midnight UTC
studio.prompt.label: Describe the style you want (optional)
studio.prompt.placeholder: e.g. glossier glaze, midnight blue tones, thicker wool…
studio.prompt.hint: Affects how the material looks, not the pattern itself.
studio.seed.label: Seed
studio.seed.hint: Same seed and same settings: same pattern.
studio.size.label: Resolution (px)
studio.size.hint: From 128 to 1024 px; out-of-range values are adjusted.
studio.regenerate.title: Replays the last generation with the same seed. “Generate pattern” draws a new variant.
studio.result.title: Result
studio.result.empty: No pattern yet. Choose your settings, then click “Generate pattern”.
studio.history.title: Session history
studio.history.note: Not kept after you close the page.
studio.history.empty: Patterns from this session will appear here.
studio.palette.unavailable: Palettes unavailable: the default palette will be used.
studio.prompt.fast_note: Available with AI render: describe the material (glaze, wool, thread…).
studio.seed.error_format: The seed must be a whole number, zero or more (e.g. 42).
studio.size.error_format: The resolution must be a whole number (e.g. 512).
studio.assist.title: Describe your idea
studio.assist.hint: In any language: the assistant suggests the craft, palette and mode. You review, then generate.
studio.assist.label: Your idea
studio.assist.placeholder: e.g. a warm rug in desert colours for a living room
studio.assist.empty: Describe your idea in a few words first.
studio.assist.applied_cta: Check the settings, then click “Generate pattern”.
studio.assist.enhance_title: Rewrite the description with the assistant
studio.assist.enhance_empty: Write a few words to improve first.
studio.assist.error.assist_disabled: The assistant is unavailable right now.
studio.assist.error.assist_ip_limit: Too many requests from your connection. Try again in a few minutes.
studio.assist.error.assist_daily_limit: The assistant has reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow.
studio.assist.error.assist_error: The assistant couldn't answer. Try again in a moment.
studio.assist.error.validation: The text must be between 1 and 500 characters.
studio.about.title: About this pattern
studio.about.note: Note written by the AI assistant, for guidance only.
studio.assist.error.assist_ip_limit_wait: Too many requests from your connection. Try again in {wait}.
